claim: Demand for AI builders with evaluation and observability skills will become a baseline requirement in enterprise AI roles.
confirming_criterion: At least 30% of sampled enterprise AI builder roles mention evaluation, monitoring, observability, or quality controls.
contradicting_criterion: Fewer than 10% of sampled enterprise AI builder roles mention these requirements.
scoring_notes: Sample review found evaluation or observability language in 36% of enterprise AI builder postings.

claim: Standalone prompt library maintenance will become a distinct premium hiring requirement.
confirming_criterion: At least 20% of sampled premium AI roles list prompt library maintenance as a standalone responsibility.
contradicting_criterion: Prompt library work appears mostly as a subtask within broader workflow or product roles.
scoring_notes: Evidence suggests prompt practices matter, but are embedded in broader product and evaluation workflows.

claim: AI Scaler demand will shift toward integration, governance, and deployment readiness rather than model experimentation.
confirming_criterion: Scaler role evidence increasingly references integration architecture, security, privacy, reliability, or governance.
contradicting_criterion: Scaler role evidence remains centered mainly on model experimentation and prototyping.
scoring_notes: Client RFPs and job evidence show rising integration and governance language.

claim: Multimodal prototyping will become a common differentiator for Prototyper placements in consumer product teams.
confirming_criterion: Consumer product roles and client briefs increasingly ask for text, image, speech, or video workflow prototypes.
contradicting_criterion: Consumer product roles continue to ask primarily for text-only assistant prototypes.
